viewing_check: Estimate 80-140, current bid $30 (22% premium on top). Three new-with-tags genuine Liberty London shirts, 17 inch collar, so a large fit. Single shirts sell A$50-125 (new with tags at the top, A$65-123), so a lot of three is worth roughly A$190-330 if sold as three separate listings. Check tags and collar size on the day, and that they are sealed and unworn. Prices are 2024-2026, rising a little in 2026. Third-party Liberty-print brands (Sportscraft, Country Road) sell lower at A$30-60 and were not used.
